card_title: Cook the Way You Want to Cook: A Home Cook's Case Against Culinary Purism
card_excerpt: Unless you own a restaurant, cook the way you want to cook. The only rules worth following are food safety and a few real technique rules — and a small set of techniques that are actually physical laws. Everything else is yours.

card_title: Why More Home Cooks Should Batch Broths: The Single Best Habit I've Ever Built
card_excerpt: Homemade broth is cheaper than the cheapest boxed broth and tastes better than the most expensive. Roast bones (don't par-boil), double-strain, fridge-skim, and reduce a quart into demi-glace cubes for the freezer.
